purpose: One-record noncommercial reference agreement diagnostic for frozen N4/Atropos v3 semantics, conditional on separately produced image-only brain support. No cohort role assignment.

nominated_record.health: publisher-described normal; no independent pathology review
nominated_record.selection: fixed before image/label access; no quality or performance selection

release.size_rule: Publisher display rounding is not a byte bound; HEAD gave no Content-Length. No acquisition byte budget authorized.

geometry.source_description: positionally normalized 3D T1, coronal; not original scanner-native frame
geometry.header_format: four ASCII numbers: cols rows number_of_slices byteswap; byteswap=0
geometry.correspondence: image slice k maps to label slice k-6; label j maps to image j+6. Thus label1 maps to image7; zero-based image z=j_zero+6.
geometry.bounds_origin: Derived from documented image slices1..65 and offset6, not observed payload size.
uncertainties: Archive member paths, headers, actual image/label dimensions, exact payload lengths and image-label correspondence not decoded.
Per-scan spacing table differs from generic 3.0mm positional-normalization narrative; use per-scan values only after header consistency check.
README does not supply enough world-axis directions/origin to fabricate scanner RAS geometry for the support producer.
Do not transfer contradictory 111_2 example (offset3) into 2_4; selected table offset6 is the frozen rule.

reference.annotation_method: trained investigators; semiautomated intensity contours plus histograms; no pure independent-voxel-manual-gold claim
reference.other_rule: Ignore, not certified background, CSF, tumor-negative, or complete extracranial truth.
reference.unannotated_slices: Exclude from scoring; retain in the image and full-image fitting support. Never zero-pad as negative labels.

fit_support.source: Proposed exact already-pinned SynthStrip main image-only algorithm used for IXI265; no IBSR labels, brain-only archive, atlas, manual label correction or post-score support tuning.
fit_support.producer_adapter: existing 6GiB MPS adapter, two threads; runtime and source-bound IBSR runner not yet prepared or released
fit_support.producer_expected_frame: same indices/shape as full source image; restored affine consistent within1e-5; world orientation first requires verified decoding
fit_support.U: B AND I==0, UNKNOWN/abstained; freeze exact count and indices from image-only preparation before any label decode
fit_support.zero_count: not assumed to equal IXI265 eight; no copied IXI265 coordinates
fit_support.rejection: Reject nonfinite or negative I, nonbinary/empty B, empty D or frame mismatch; no intensity shift, clipping, manual repair or fallback.
fit_support.oracle_alternative: Requires a new explicitly named oracle-support protocol; this version cannot silently switch. Any oracle-support study must disallow extraction accuracy.

frozen_fitter.native_grid: full publisher grid, no crop/resampling or cross-person registration
frozen_fitter.order_rule: Class means of N4-corrected intensities over all D must satisfy mu1<mu2<mu3 before labels are opened. Empty class, tie or reversal aborts; no reordering, Hungarian mapping, label-guided permutation or retry.
frozen_fitter.posterior_rule: Unmodified membership probabilities, not physical PVE; finite [0,1], zero outside D, per-voxel sum error<=2e-5 inside D; no normalization/clip.
frozen_fitter.fitter_source_binding: Existing runner is IXI265-only and expects exactly eight frozen UNKNOWN cells. Do not invoke it on IBSR. A separately reviewed source-bound adapter must preserve this kernel and parameters while pinning IBSR I/B/D/U and source frame before label access.

blind_order: 0. Resolve documented noncommercial scope, authorized existing access/extra terms and bounded acquisition plan; none released here.
1. Freeze decoder, verified frame, exact pinned image-only support producer/runtime, source-bound v3 adapter and scorer on generated controls; keep labels inaccessible.

2. After a separately authorized bounded image-archive transfer, materialize only 2_4 from the full-image archive and keep other records unopened. Keep label archive/payload inaccessible until predictions are sealed. Decode image only, check metadata/shape/frame, run the fixed image-only support producer, seal I/B/D/U hashes and UNKNOWN indices. Do not acquire/open brain-only data.
3. One fixed v3 fit. Seal source hashes, support, corrected image, raw classes/posteriors, parameter/runtime hashes and prediction-only numerical checks. No tissue-label access in the fit worker.

4. Only after the sealed prediction record, separately authorized label access may materialize/decode 2_4 labels. Scorer applies offset6 and fixed code mapping; no image/label registration search. Geometry or label-code mismatch yields INVALID and no refit.
5. Score once; retain all failed/invalid outcomes and report all predeclared metrics, support omissions and abstentions. No threshold tuning, retry, best-case selection or promotion.

scoring.primary_domain: E = represented annotation slices AND R in {128,192,254}; do not intersect E with D for primary metrics.
scoring.prediction_on_E: raw class1..3 on D; ABSTAIN for E outside D (including both missed B support and U).
scoring.confusion: 3 reference rows CSF/GM/WM;4 prediction columns CSF/GM/WM/ABSTAIN. Count all E voxels.
per_class: TP: R=c and P=c. FP: R!=c and P=c within E. FN: R=c and P!=c within E, including ABSTAIN.
Dice=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); recall=TP/(TP+FN); precision=TP/(TP+FP). Zero denominator -> NA, never1.
Predicted and reference volumes within E in mm3 using1.171751*1.171751*3.125; signed volume difference and relative error=(Vpred-Vref)/Vref, NA ifVref0.
scoring.macro_dice: Arithmetic mean of3 per-class Dice only if all3 defined; otherwise NA plus absent-class counts. No acceptance threshold.
support_reporting: Full-image |B|,|D|,|U| and exact U indices sealed before labels.
|E| and per-class reference counts; |E outside B|, |E intersect U|, |E intersect D|, with per-class coverage |R=c intersect D|/|R=c|.
Number of annotation slices, ignored zero voxels, unannotated image slices, predictions within ignored voxels and unannotated slices; excluded counts must accompany metrics.
scoring.secondary_domain: E intersect D; same metrics, explicitly conditional-on-estimated-support and never substituted for primary metrics.
scoring.boundary_metrics: Not included: partial coverage, uncertain zero-domain semantics and anisotropic slices confound whole-brain surface claims.
scoring.posterior_metrics: Not included: annotations hard and posterior not physical PVE.
scoring.extraction_accuracy: Not measured; reference0/coverage not established complete brain-negative truth.
scoring.scoring_implementation: Not yet written or tested; must be independently checked on generated controls against formulas before label access.

rights.precedence: Andrew Worth22Jan2018 states current NITRC license prevails over older MGH README; no broader commercial or redistribution permission inferred.
rights.historical_notice: 1997 README restricts segmentation research and requires acknowledgment, participation and permission for anatomical/morphological studies, image publication and commercial product use. Preserved verbatim locally; do not overwrite historical qualification.
rights.extra_terms_after_login: UNKNOWN; login not followed; none accepted

overlap.IBSR18_20_crosswalk: UNKNOWN; cannot count18+20 as38 independent people
overlap.other_cohort_crosswalk: UNKNOWN, including NFBS/LPBA40/Lausanne and support-model training ancestry
overlap.within_image_fit: Atropos uses no pretrained tissue weights; its annotation independence is not a proof of cohort or model independence

blockers: Both required archive HEAD requests redirect to login; public unauthenticated payload access unavailable on inspected routes. Existing authorized access and any extra terms unknown.
Current project noncommercial eligibility not established; exact archive lengths/hashes and bounded acquisition plan unavailable.
Selected raw-image axis/frame decoding and label geometry not verified; no fabricated RAS affine.
No IBSR-specific source-bound support/fitter/scorer preparation exists. Existing IXI265 runner cannot be repurposed as-is.
release_decision.why_not_IXI_anatomy_validation: Different person, scanner/contrast, resolution, preparation and label method. Agreement on one IBSR record tests implementation/reference agreement only; supplies no IXI265 voxel truth or tumor/vessel/skull/functional/host validation.
